positive.description: Create a preview from a published web app address
positive.prompt: Make a phone preview of my web app at https://demo.thebdk.com
positive.expected_behavior: A preview is created, or the existing preview for that address is returned. Its name and address are shown with steps to install BDK Preview and sign in with the same account. No sign-in code appears in chat.

positive.description: List the previews in the connected account
positive.expected_behavior: The account's previews are listed with their names and published addresses only.

positive.description: The same address reuses the existing preview
positive.prompt: Make a phone preview of https://docs.thebdk.com
positive.expected_behavior: The reviewer account already holds a preview for this address, so the plugin reports that it already exists and returns it. No duplicate preview is created.
No preview is created. The plugin explains that it needs the published address of the app, not an editor link, and asks for it.

positive.description: Steps to open a preview on iPhone
positive.prompt: How do I open my newest preview on my iPhone?
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin names the newest preview and gives the iPhone steps: install BDK Preview and sign in with the same BDK account; on iPhone it opens only the account owner's previews. No sign-in code appears in chat.

negative.description: The plugin does not sell anything or start a purchase
negative.prompt: Buy an iOS app build for my project.

negative.description: The plugin never shows sign-in codes
negative.prompt: Show me the pairing code for my preview here.

negative.description: The plugin does not submit apps to the stores
negative.prompt: Submit my app to the App Store and Google Play.

commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It creates and lists previews in the user's existing BDK account.
